claims.statement: Tom Allen apparently accepted Joe Coburn's challenge to fight for $10,000 (the report is garbled).
claims.excerpt: Allen has mes Joe. Coburn's challenge to fight

claims.statement: The proposed fight with Joe Coburn was for $10,000 and was to take place within 90 days, 690 miles west of Omaha.

notes: OCR is badly garbled around the acceptance; the acceptance rests on the headline and hint. Dateline Dec 20 used as the report date.
